the actual-state validator and its permitted branches

the API DTO and response writer

notification sender owns delivery retries and signing
provider returns service CPU utilization rather than exposing a monitoring vendor's client
plugin design document proposes isolated processes and versioned RPC

main constructs MemoryService and directly starts controller loops
key derivation hashes `orch:` plus the controller name
release fast path returns immediately when Done is already closed
wrapper implementation contains no acquisition retry loop
agent checker compares its parsed tuple against pinned bounds

transaction sequence records the version only with successful SQL application
lock wrapper attempts unlock even when the callback fails
explicit guard is an authorization boundary
control-plane check first searches for relevant enabled windows
operation test verifies an outside-window rollout rejection and an audited forced request

retention fixture checks an old event, active task, unresolved failure, and resolved failure
checks ORCH_SCHEMA_CHECK only when its value equals true ignoring case
creation implementation deduplicates by task identity
fake-runtime tests check recorded operations and concurrent same-task creation
default entry point selects the fake explicitly
randomized invariant test uses five fixed seeds
reconciler test reruns reconciliation and checks duplicate work
chaos suite starts with repeated running reports against one memory control plane
relevant code contains no new MemoryService after the rollout begins
fake options permit pull, create, start, inspect, and list failures
returned-node test supplies no active assignment and a managed stale container
assertion prevents a false assignment history
collector definitions provide exact names and labels
access-log middleware records only paths recognized by metricRoute
call site does not test whether this is the first failed transition
registry handler exposes Prometheus text for its own registry
scrape configuration uses fifteen-second scrape and evaluation intervals
initial convergence loop includes service creation and synthetic running reports
debug handler registers pprof routes only when enabled
scale test is behind the scale build tag
workflow configures a PostgreSQL service for its quality job
Makefile lint target falls back to formatting checks and go vet when golangci-lint is absent
agent systemd unit joins the docker group and grants socket access
